meta.name: readout
meta.description: Prepare a sponsor update separating promised outcomes, measured results and customer acceptance. Use for progress readouts or defending a delivery claim.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把承诺产出、实测结果与客户验收分栏写清,交出一份站得住脚的进度汇报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 需要向赞助方或高层说明项目进展,并回应交付成果的质疑
copy.tagline_en: Draft a sponsor update that separates promises, measured results and customer sign-off
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must report project progress to a sponsor or exec and defend delivery claims

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你准备面向赞助方的进度汇报,把承诺的结果、实测结果和客户验收分开列出,并如实保留未知项。也可用于进度通报或为交付主张辩护。
howto.when: 当你需要做进度通报,或要为某项交付主张辩护时触发;若由 @fde 调用,则复用其当前的脱敏数据包与范围,不重新开始设置。

say.text: 帮我准备一份给赞助方的进度汇报,分清承诺结果和实测结果。
say.note: 按承诺、实测、验收三类分开列出。

say.text: 客户验收还没完成,请在汇报里如实标注。
say.note: 保留未决项,不写成已完成。

say.text: 用 @fde 现有的数据包做这次进度通报。
say.note: 沿用其范围,不重新走设置和提问。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude prepares a sponsor update that separates promised outcomes, measured results and customer acceptance, and keeps unknowns marked as unknown. It can also be used for progress readouts or to defend a delivery claim.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a progress readout or must defend a delivery claim; if called by @fde, it reuses that run's current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: Prepare a sponsor progress readout separating promised and measured results.
say_en.note: Lists promised, measured and acceptance items separately.

say_en.text: Customer acceptance isn't done yet; mark it honestly in the readout.
say_en.note: Keeps open items open, not claimed as complete.

say_en.text: Use the existing @fde packet for this progress readout.
say_en.note: Reuses its scope without restarting setup.
